evidence_summary: GBDC page has Directory > List of Book Sellers and table headers S/N, Name, Specialisation, Postal/Location, E-Mail/Website, Contact No.
Observed S/N entries run from 1 to 47 on the official list.
BAN home says it helps booksellers and bookstores in Nigeria and describes its members as certified booksellers.
BAN members page exposes member blocks with description, products/services, address, email, phone, website.
Search/index evidence shows Librairies du Maroc with map/bookshop pages; direct fetch blocked in tool.
GoAfrica Morocco Librairie category reports 1,273 results and exposes business rows with location/contact/profile links.
ALI page says discover the libraries in its network and shows filters/sample stores; it says the full member list is being updated.
Sample ALI profile exposes description, services, other products, hours, email, phone, address.
ILAB says 101 antiquarian booksellers belong to ALAI and that ALAI is a rare/antiquarian association.
UBI official site lists Interactive map of Ukrainian book ecosystem under digital/activities.
UBI Research 2025 reports approximately 800 brick-and-mortar bookstores and 80 online shops in 2024.
Interfax reports UBI said the interactive map had reached 500 registered bookstores in June 2024.
